answer: An farming party hence has to keep every alias continuously active for 24 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The vault counter is kept in yarrow and grove publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 24 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4472 identities would post 2398 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
